summary_1line: Vibhishana defects from Ravana and seeks refuge with Rama, prompting the monkey leaders to debate whether he is sincere or a dangerous spy.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vibhishana, radiant with jewels and weapons, hovers in the sky with four rakshasas as the monkey army below raises trees and rocks in alarm.
Sugriva angrily warns Rama while the monkey chiefs cluster around, gripping boulders and tree trunks, watching the distant figure of Vibhishana.
Vibhishana stands at the northern shore with folded hands, declaring his refuge in Rama before the suspicious monkey warriors.
